rationale: The export command passes all functional checks: required path and status handling, numeric ordering, filtering, missing-parent creation, storage preservation, atomic replacement, stable summaries, and banner-free JSON. The atomic helper has appropriate temporary-file cleanup and the command is wired into help and focused tests. The required asset is not fully compliant: deterministic checks identify forbidden lowercase characters on seven lines, so the delivered feature misses an explicit constraint despite otherwise correct behavior. EXPORT is prominent and the bordered module/status layout is readable, but it is generic status text rather than a distinctive export depiction, with modest hierarchy and repeated empty rows. The added .gitattributes entry is directly related to newline stability, and no tampering or unrelated clutter is evidenced.
